blocks.text: This Peer-to-Peer Car Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is made as of {{date}}, between:

items: Pickup Date/Time: {{pickup_date}} at {{pickup_time}}
Return Date/Time: {{return_date}} at {{return_time}}
Total Rental Duration: {{rental_hours}} hours / {{rental_days}} days
Pickup Location: {{pickup_location}}
Return Location: {{return_location}}
Daily Rate: {{daily_rate}} per day
Hourly Rate: {{hourly_rate}} per hour (if applicable)
Base Rental Charge: {{base_rental_charge}}
Security Deposit: {{security_deposit}} (authorized on renter's credit card)
Insurance Option: {{insurance_option}}
{{additional_fees}}
Total Estimated Charges: {{total_estimated_charges}}
Provide a valid driver's license ({{license_requirement}}) and be at least {{minimum_age}} years old.
Provide valid insurance coverage meeting the requirements in Section 5.
Not drive under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or any impairing substance.
Not drive recklessly, violate traffic laws, or engage in illegal activity.
Not allow any person not listed on this Agreement to drive the Vehicle.
Not sublease, lend, or share the Vehicle with any other person.
Not use the Vehicle for commercial purposes, ride-sharing services, or delivery services.
Not operate the Vehicle outside of {{allowed_geographic_area}}.
Not modify, alter, or tamper with the Vehicle in any way.
Not track or record GPS/location data except as required by Owner's technology.
Not engage in joyriding, racing, or off-road driving.
{{renter_obligations}}
Renter must maintain personal auto insurance covering the Vehicle for the rental period.
Required minimum liability coverage: {{liability_minimum}} per person / {{liability_per_accident}} per accident.
Renter must provide proof of insurance to Owner before taking possession.
Owner's insurance (if any) is secondary and covers only damages exceeding Renter's coverage.
Renter is responsible for: (a) any deductible under Owner's policy, (b) any damage exceeding Renter's insurance limits, (c) loss of use during repairs.
Renter may purchase supplemental insurance through {{insurance_provider}}.
{{insurance_terms}}
Renter must inspect the Vehicle at pickup and note any existing damage on the inspection form.
Owner shall disclose all known damage prior to pickup.
Renter accepts the Vehicle in its current condition, "as-is."
Any damage occurring during the rental period is Renter's responsibility.
Vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level as at pickup.
If returned with less fuel, Renter will be charged {{fuel_replenishment_rate}} per gallon for replenishment.
Vehicle must be returned clean (interior vacuumed, trash removed) or Renter will be charged a cleaning fee of {{cleaning_fee}}.
Vehicle must be returned at the agreed time and location.
Late returns: {{late_return_fee}} per hour after the agreed return time.

blocks.text: In the event of an accident, Renter must:

items: Stop immediately and ensure the safety of all persons.
Call emergency services if necessary.
Exchange information with other parties involved.
Take photos of the scene and vehicle damage.
Notify Owner within {{accident_notification_hours}} hours.
File a police report if required by law or if damage exceeds {{police_report_threshold}}.
Not admit fault or settle claims privately without Owner's consent.
Security deposit: {{security_deposit}} will be authorized on Renter's credit card.
Deposit will be released within {{deposit_release_period}} after return, subject to any deductions.
Owner may deduct from deposit for: vehicle damage, excessive cleaning, smoking, missing items, unpaid fees, late return charges, traffic fines, or other violations.
Renter may terminate early by returning the Vehicle and notifying Owner.
Early termination fee: {{early_termination_fee}}.
Owner may terminate and retain the deposit if Renter violates any terms.
If Owner terminates, Renter receives a prorated refund of unused rental charges.

blocks.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior agreements and representations.
